query:
update chunks c set
             ordinal = k.ordinal, start_offset = k.start_offset, end_offset = k.end_offset,
             content_type = $5, ts = $6, title = $7
         from unnest($1::uuid[], $2::int[], $3::int[], $4::int[])
             as k(id, ordinal, start_offset, end_offset)
         where c.id = k.id
